summaryZh: Lipomi Research Group 研究能源、仿生材料与器件以及绿色化学和纳米制造的交叉领域。聚合物机械及界面性质是主要方向，涉及机械测试、合成聚合物化学、分子建模和软材料表征。
researchQuestions: 材料科学工具如何帮助理解人的触觉？

evidence.quote: Welcome to The Lipomi Research Group in the Department of Chemical Engineering at the University of Rochester.
energy, biomimetic materials and devices, and green chemistry and nanomanufacturing.
This project combines mechanical testing with the physics of devices under strain.
This project involves synthetic polymer chemistry, molecular modeling, and the characterization of soft materials.
We are interested in how the tools of materials science can be used to understand the human sense of touch.
